limitations: Complete theorem-level texts of several older KS papers were not all inspected, so an equivalent classical \(\nu=1\) observation under different terminology remains possible. The general-flux statements require the regularity stated in the package; global attraction is asserted unconditionally only for the classical one-dimensional periodic KS flow.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and audit limitations are documented in RESULT.md and the independent-audit files.
